name: Paerisades II
role: King of the Bosporan Kingdom from 284 to 245 BC

checks.lead: Paerisades II (Greek: Παιρισάδης; died c. 245 BC) or Parysades was king of the Bosporan Kingdom from 284 to 245 BC. He may have been a son of either Spartokos III, or Satyros II.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
